meta.title: AgentBridge — Agent Session Lifecycle
meta.subtitle: State Machine, Lock Acquisition, and Supervision
meta.description: Lifecycle state transitions for AgentBridge sessions from creation to termination, including workspace locking, watchdog supervision, loop detection, and process tree teardown.

states.label: IDLE
states.description: Session created in SQLite / memory with unique session_id and project metadata. No subprocess or workspace lock active.

states.label: STARTING
states.description: Acquiring workspace READ/WRITE lock, initializing adapter descriptor, resolving executable path, incrementing session generation counter.

states.label: RUNNING
states.description: Subprocess active with clean environment. Output streaming with backpressure debouncing. AgentSupervisor watchdog tracking health snapshots.

states.label:
BLOCKED
(Loop / Stalled)
states.description: AgentLoopDetector identified oscillation, repeated command, or repeated error. Emits AGENT_BLOCKED event to ChatOps for intervention.

states.label: STOPPING
states.description: Graceful SIGINT/SIGTERM sent to adapter subprocess tree. Bounded stop timeout timer armed.

states.label: STOPPED
states.description: Process terminated (force killed with taskkill /T /F on Windows if timeout exceeded). Workspace lock released. Session grants cleared.

states.label: FAILED
states.description: Process exited unexpectedly, startup failure, or unrecoverable adapter crash. Error message captured for diagnosis. Can transition to STARTING for restart.

transitions.description: Operator triggers session start. Lock acquired and environment prepared.
Adapter process is alive, stdout/stderr listeners attached.
Startup failed or workspace lock acquisition timed out.

transitions.trigger: Loop or stall detected by supervisor
transitions.description: AgentLoopDetector triggers AGENT_BLOCKED; supervisor alerts operator.
New prompt resets health monitor and resumes execution.
Controlled shutdown initiated with bounded timeout.
Uncontrolled termination detected by monitor thread.
Resources and workspace locks fully released.
Force kill executed after grace period expires.
Failed session can be re-launched with fresh generation.
